maria (PM): Quick question — should we add a first-class 'per-model breakdown' saved view in Console analytics for routes? Support keeps asking for an easy way to see per-route latency/cost by model.
kevin (Eng): +1 but worried about UI clutter. Maybe make it a preset under "Saved Views" instead of always-on.
sara (Design): I like presets. We can put them in a lightweight dropdown and show an active chip when applied so users know scope. Need to be explicit about 'scope: route' vs 'scope: org'.
aj (DevEx): API note: current saved_query API only stores query_string and name. We'll need scope, view_type, and pinned filters in the payload for export/import and infra scripts.
kevin (Eng): can you sketch the minimal API change?
aj (DevEx): ```
PATCH /api/v1/saved_queries/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "name": "Per-route model breakdown",
  "scope": "route",
  "filters": ["model:open-llama-3","latency_ms>100"],
  "view": "per_model_table",
  "pinned": false
}
```
maria (PM): That looks right. Also want the UI to show an estimated quota/cost impact when you apply a saved view (tokens/min estimate + monthly cost delta). Users ask that a lot.
kevin (Eng): We'll need to compute sample-based estimates server-side. Telemetry needs to expose per-route token rate and per-model token distribution, otherwise estimate will be rough. Any perf cost?
lambda-bot: telemetry_service alert: metrics.route.tokens_per_min and metrics.route.model_token_share available as cluster metrics.
sara (Design): If we show cost delta, add an 'estimated' badge and a hover modal linking to the sample calculation and confidence interval. Keep it non-blocking.
aj (DevEx): For rollout UX: saved view rollout should support gradual exposure — feature flags + per-team visibility. Also capture audit trail: created_by, created_at, last_applied_by.
kevin (Eng): Implementation plan: extend saved_queries table. Option A: add jsonb meta (fast) — Option B: add typed columns for scope, view_type, pinned (better for indexing). I'm leaning to adding columns for the main fields and keeping a metadata json for extras.
maria (PM): prefer explicit columns for critical fields (scope, view_type, pinned) so we can query and enforce perms fast. Keep jsonb for misc.
sara (Design): I'll mock the dropdown, chip states, and the cost-preview popover. Can deliver a micro-proto by EOD.
kevin (Eng): Migration note: we'll need a backfill job for existing saved queries to populate scope (default org) and view_type (default query_table). Backfill can run async. Also add an index on (scope, view_type).
aj (DevEx): Also suggest adding a telemetry tag saved_query.used_by (counts) so we can measure adoption and rollouts.
kevin (Eng): good call. I'll add a metric for usage events when a saved view is applied.
maria (PM): Next steps: kevin + aj 30m sync to align API + DB migration. sara will attach mock. I'll open a ticket with acceptance criteria (scope filter, cost preview, rollout flags, audit fields).
aj (DevEx): pinging @kevin for sync. I'm free 10:30am tomorrow.
kevin (Eng): 10:30 works.
maria (PM): thanks team :rocket:
_meta: This thread is a product+eng discussion about adding per-route per-model saved view presets, API changes, DB migration, telemetry and rollout UX. Kept short and action-oriented.
